info.text:
Thursday's stock sell-off wiped out about $3 trillion in value from S&P 500 companies.
The S&P 500 fell 4.4% and the Nasdaq 5.5% on Nov 5, their worst days since April 2025.
The chip stock index fell about 12%, its worst day since March 2020.
The Nasdaq is about 12% below its Oct 6 record: its second correction of 2026, after March.
Sources: Reuters, CNN, NBC News, Benzinga.
News and education, not financial advice.
